Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study describes two main MS workflows: 1) a targeted immuno-MRM assay for antibody screening and validation (using light/heavy peptide ratios), and 2) a shotgun IP-MS workflow (DDA) for protein-level validation. The DDA workflow used for the PRIDE dataset (PXD012130) is the primary focus for routing, which involves AP-MS and phosphopeptide detection.

Fifty-six mAbs with positive immunoprecipitation using recombinant proteins were subsequently tested by IP-MS using MCF10A-KRAS and MCF10A-empty vector cell lysates.
Following incubation, 50 uL of Protein A/G agarose beads (1861760, Pierce) was added to each IP group tube, and the mixtures were incubated overnight at 4 °C.
